request.task: T3C2 residual closure for definitive live Canvas Agent Studio oracle
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied; this is a static adversarial review of scripts/e2e/canvas-contract.mjs, not a live run. The Agent Studio oracle now gates on a live data-edit-id, keyboard-selects QA Challenger only after asserting the first roster radio is checked and QA Challenger is unchecked, holds the teammate POST with try/finally release+unroute, forbids that editId in JSON/headers/empty query/decoded pathname, requires native disabled on Assignment and Data class (and mode buttons) while the submit stays aria-disabled without native disabled, rejects wraparound until Tab has left the outside anchor, and waitFor(attached) on the retained wrapper before count/hidden/inert proofs. No concrete MEDIUM+ false-green, silent skip, or unbounded deadlock is present in the new control flow.
residual_risks: Duplicate-POST waitForRequest uses a 750ms timeout; a delayed second POST after that window but after result commit/unroute would not be counted.
editId absence is substring includes() on decoded pathname/JSON/headers; very short or encoded-in-headers IDs could false-red or miss a non-plaintext header leak.
createProposal actions use button[type=submit] while existence is waited via the accessible name; those nodes are only coupled later by focus identity.
Tab-cycle wraparound can false-red if focus starts on a non-tabbable (body) or sticks on the preview iframe; 256 steps will not wrap in that case.
getAttribute('disabled') === '' is stricter than HTML boolean disabled (disabled="disabled" would false-red).
selectFirstSection still logs-and-continues if the breadcrumb never appears; Agent Studio then depends on the boundary hasText(editId) gate rather than workbench selection.
No live proof was attached, so compact View/Edit panel collapse and real network glob matching for **/api/ai-teammates/* were not observed.
